From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>

Subject: [Action] Q3 pricing lanes — commit certification needed

Team — quick hygiene ask as we close the month: finance asked for explicit signal on any deals that should be counted as committed for the Q3 forecast. I exported a short CSV (attached) with our top 10 at-risk deals and the current concession details. Please do the following by EOD tomorrow: 

- Mark each row with: COMMIT / PROSPECT / AT-RISK
- Confirm final approved concession (if any) and upload the signed quote/PO to the HubSpot deal (link below)
- If deal desk sign-off is required, note the ticket ID in the sheet

Top two items I want eyes on: MosaicEdge (D-9832) — proposed 18% starter discount with 12-month ARR commit; Solstice AI renewal (attached quote) — customer requested an additional 5% to match competitor pricing.

Why this matters: Finance will only treat items marked COMMIT as forecast-recognized for the week-27 rollup. If we have approved concessions that are not certified, they will be excluded from committed revenue.

Attachments: q3-pricing-lanes.csv
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/D-9832
DealDesk: https://dealdesk.redwood.com/tickets/DEALDESK-4521

Thanks — short, actionable updates please.

— Jasmine Liu
Account Director, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Thanks Jasmine — quick updates on my side: 

- MosaicEdge (D-9832): Sales agreed to 18% starter discount and 12-month ARR commit. I opened a DealDesk ticket for official approval (DEALDESK-4521) and attached the proposed concession rationale. Expect approval by EOD tomorrow.
- Solstice AI renewal: Priya and I discussed. They're evaluating internal procurement timeline; finance@solsticeai.com asked for a single-year PO to align with vendor review. I've attached the latest quote (SOL-Quote-v3.pdf) and asked Priya to confirm PO timing.
- WindRiver Labs (smaller deal): moving to PROSPECT — no discount granted.

Action: I'll update the CSV now with provisional COMMIT on MosaicEdge pending DealDesk approval. Will move Solstice to COMMIT only after PO confirmation from Priya.

Ben

Next steps: Ben to upload signed MosaicEdge contract to HubSpot and update the DealDesk ticket. Laura — please include MosaicEdge in the week-27 committed revenue line-item. I'll follow up on Solstice next week after PO receipt.

Thanks everyone for the quick responses — appreciate the fast turnaround to keep the forecast clean.
